verdict: LEAD CANDIDATE - rodent only; validate before use
note: The only registry reagent explicitly raised against the P2X3 EXTRACELLULAR domain. Vendor applications are ICC/IF, WB, IHC(F) - live-cell surface labelling is NOT a listed application and appears in 0 of 97 open-access surface/live-cell papers screened. Reacts mouse/rat only: not usable for human work. Polyclonal, so no orientation control for conjugation. Immunogen sequence not disclosed in registry - request it from the vendor and check it falls inside aa 44-322 before ordering.

verdict: DO NOT USE for targeting - epitope is CYTOPLASMIC
note: Most-cited P2X3 antibody in the field. Vendor epitope (C)VEKQSTDSGAYSIGH maps to aa 383-397, which is C-terminal cytoplasmic (ectodomain is 44-322) - it cannot bind an intact cell. Also note the listed peptide is the RAT sequence; human P2X3 383-397 is AEKQSTDSGAFSIGH (13/15 identical). Fine for WB/IHC on permeabilized tissue; unusable as a targeting ligand.

verdict: BACKUP - epitope undisclosed, confirm before use
note: Broadest species reactivity of the P2X3 reagents found (h/m/r), which matters given the ectodomain is 95.7% conserved human-vs-rat. Registry lists no epitope and no surface/flow application (ICC/IF, IHC-P, WB). Request the immunogen sequence and confirm it lies within aa 44-322.

verdict: CAUTION - flow listed but epitope undisclosed
note: Registry comments list flow cytometry among applications, but give no epitope and no indication whether flow was on permeabilized cells. Whole antiserum, not purified IgG - unsuitable for conjugation without affinity purification.

verdict: NOTE - binds cytoplasmic tail, not for targeting
note: Found co-cited in the P2X3 literature scan. Broad species reactivity, but H68.4 is raised against the TfR cytoplasmic domain - it is a detection reagent, not a transcytosis ligand. Does not replace OX-26 / RI7217 for targeting.

verdict: STRONGEST epitope match - immunogen is the whole ectodomain; but listed for WB only, surface binding unvalidated

reacts: human (listed); rat 92.2% id at those positions
verdict: Human-reactive extracellular option; complements A10232 (rat). IHC only - surface binding unvalidated
Only P2X3 reagent with flow cytometry listed and pre-conjugated variants; epitope must be requested before trusting
